CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 11, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Community Development Conference Room
  of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Corona, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger;
  Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Stanley Tsai

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – July 14, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the July 14, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the July 14, 2026, Regular Meeting of the
  Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-065
  • 330 North Story Place
  • Applicant: Glynn Norgan
  • Request: This is an application for the replacement of multiple
  existing windows on an existing single-family residence.
  1
  08/11/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-123
  • 1503 South Marguerita Avenue
  • Applicant: Pauline Chen
  • Request: This is an application for the replacement of multiple
  existing windows and the construction of a new laundry room addition
  at the rear of Unit 1503 D within a multi-family property.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the graphical error depicting the existing front porch
  column at Unit 1503 D, as shown on Sheet AB-204, to
  accurately indicate a painted wood finish instead of the
  currently depicted stucco finish.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-118
  • 3308 Danzig Place
  • Applicant: Cliff Weinan
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to the front
  portion of an existing single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  2
  08/11/2026
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-041
  • 126 South Cordova Street
  • Applicant: Ricky Yiu Chao
  • Request: This is an application for the demolition of the existing
  covered front porch and the construction of a new trellised entry
  porch, along with a new exterior paint scheme, for an existing single-
  family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Reduce the proposed column pier height so that the top of
  each pier is horizontally aligned with the window sill, thereby
  establishing a more balanced relationship between the porch
  elements and the building façade.
  2. In response to Condition #1, reduce the height of the
  proposed porch railing to maintain appropriate scale and
  proportion between the lowered column piers. Since the porch
  floor is less than 30” above adjacent grade, the railing height
  may be reduced below the standard 42” guardrail height,
  subject to compliance with applicable building code
  requirements.
  3. Revise the proposed porch railing design to a wood picket
  style incorporating varied picket and rail dimensions to
  provide greater architectural depth and visual interest. The
  revised railing shall complement the existing wood fencing on
  the property while maintaining compatibility with the
  Craftsman-style character.
  MOTION:
  • Moved to continue the application with the following considerations:
  1. The applicant should continue to refine and study the
  proposed front porch design, incorporating the considerations
  and recommendations verbally expressed by the Design
  Review Board during its discussion of this agenda item.

  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.

  3
  08/11/2026
   •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Corona, Udani, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Ng
  Absent:  Tsai

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:53 P.M. to
  Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  Nora Corona
